'''Mackerel''' are a type of aquatic [[vermin]] found in [[temperate]] and [[biome|arctic]] [[ocean]]s year-round, and are a ready source of [[food]] when [[fish cleaning|cleaned]] at a [[fishery]].

Some [[dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] mackerel for their ''stripes''.
